r800-21.text:
To: Henry Clark
From: Member Services, Business Insight Weekly
Subject: Your subscription ends soon
Customer number: 20417

Dear Mr. Clark,

Your subscription to Business Insight Weekly will end on June 30. To continue receiving the publication without interruption, please [1] ------- your subscription before that date.

As a loyal reader, you are [2] ------- for an exclusive rate of $79 per year, a saving of 20 percent on the regular price. You will also keep full access to our online library, which contains more than ten years of articles and market analysis.

The process is simple. Visit our website, enter the customer number shown above, and choose a payment method. [3] -------, you may call a customer representative at 555-0199 on weekdays between 9:00 A.M. and 5:00 P.M.

Thank you for your continued support.

Member Services
r800-21.zh:
收件人：Henry Clark
寄件人：Business Insight Weekly 會員服務部
主旨：您的訂閱即將到期
客戶編號：20417

Clark 先生您好：

您訂閱的 Business Insight Weekly 將於 6 月 30 日到期。為了讓您不間斷地收到本刊，請在該日期之前續訂。

身為忠實讀者，您有資格享有每年 79 美元的專屬優惠價，比原價省下 20%。您也可以繼續完整使用我們的線上資料庫，裡面收錄了十多年來的文章和市場分析。

手續很簡單：請上我們的網站，輸入上方所示的客戶編號，再選擇付款方式即可。或者，您也可以在週一至週五上午 9 點至下午 5 點之間，撥 555-0199 與客服代表聯絡。

感謝您長期的支持。

會員服務部
